content: Yahwe, nu du hogok nadisukilitigamulat tiŋa titiŋ didimeniŋ tiŋat wondoktiŋa nu mede gineŋ yale me didimeniŋ nanimbeŋ.

Yahwe, du welegedi nabukahile hinek tilaŋ doktiŋa helemahelemaŋ nehitubu-lodaune mede biyagoŋ takalilat. Unduŋ doktiŋa du titiŋne hogohogok u kanadidapmaŋ tibeŋ. Tiŋa welene eŋ nadinadine diniŋ mebi kameka tiŋa nadiweŋ.
Nu adi me hogohi dut mu yaulat eŋ me yalaŋ yoiŋ heki dut maaŋ undugoŋ mu yaulat.
Nu adi me kadakaniŋ tiiŋ u yabukwihita tilat. Unduŋ tiŋa me kadakahi adi yabuŋa sigilulum tiyemiŋa yaulat.
Nu kadakaniŋnenit mokit nabunadiweŋdok kohone youtela altage kelemadiŋa ganiutumbalat.
Nu unduŋ tiŋa ganiutumbadok kap niŋ gibitaŋ tolat, eŋ du titiŋ momohi tuguŋ u yohautalat.
Yahwe, nu adi welenedi du yoke u kahilehinaka tilat, uŋoŋ adi saŋiniŋge uŋgoniŋdi hatak.
Du me kadakaniŋ tiiŋ heki dut mu nehitomboyouleŋ. Tiŋa me mik-kwadi tiŋa nohiye widikumiiŋ heki gut mu nehitubu-kadakaweŋ.
Me heki woŋ adi kadakaniŋ helemahelemaŋ tiiŋ. Adi me noli muneeŋ foloŋ yenihohoket tubune metam noli kadakaniŋ tiyemiiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ nu adi titiŋ didimeniŋ tilat. Unduŋ doktiŋa siloŋ tobogoŋ tiŋa kotigoŋ nanagileŋ.
Unduŋ tinambune nemek niŋdi tuwot mu nehitubu-kadakawek, mooŋ. Fafaŋe tiŋa yatat. Yahwe, metam youtumbadok bopneune nu adi lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ wohoge ganintiloit.
